text: Baseline first: the box, board, ramp and empty scenes are recorded with RGB + amplitude after ground-detection-robustness run 4, without rclpy probes on the client, and their replay numbers (guidance off, gate off) are written down before anything is tuned; ground truth from the ChArUco board pose.

ToF amplitude guidance: per-pixel confidence from the pixel-aligned amplitude image; low-amplitude pixels dropped so the albedo bias on the printed board drops to p95 |h| <= 2 cm while >= 95 % of the floor 0.3-2.0 m is kept.

RGB-guided edges: boundaries of depth-detected lethal regions (obstacles, drops) snapped to RGB edges through the head_rgbd_cpp guided upsampling, so the box edge error drops from ~5 cm to <= 2 cm on replay.

No-return areas: where the RGB sees non-floor and the ToF has no returns (the black ramp) a no_return caution warning area is published, never free and never lethal, with null heights accepted by costmap_zones, mcp_server and web_ui.
RGB never creates a lethal obstacle by itself, heights only from depth; texture-only edges on flat floor (board, tile seams, shadows) do not add obstacles.
Replay recordings that include RGB + amplitude, replay tests against the measured ground truth, the Pi 5 CPU budget measured, and README/runbook/tests updated.
Graded traversability cost declined: the free / warning / lethal tiers and the rule (step > 0.04 m or slope > 15 deg) stay unchanged.

No new nodes; C++ for robot nodes except web_ui and mcp_server; live data via the web_ui websocket only, never rclpy probes on the client; recordings with the robot static and charging, head moves allowed.
